title: Consume State on Transition
goal: Enforce one-way state transitions by taking ownership of self.
hints: To move non-Copy fields out of the old state, the receiver must take ownership.
The Dirty struct expects a String field matching the inner name type.
explanation: Typestate transition methods must take `self` by value to consume the original state. Taking `&self` or `&mut self` fails with error `E0507` because you cannot move non-Copy fields out of a reference. Passing `self.state` or `self` into the `name` field produces type mismatch error `E0308`.
